Name: Wheat
Notes: KIND says where it comes from. `raw` arrives from outside the brewery - a match reward, the Traveling Brewer, an adventure. `made` is produced by one of the six sections. `tool` is a piece of equipment.

Name: Water
Notes: The one thing three different sections all want. Keep the Start high.

Name: Hammer
Notes: KEPT = yes means it is NOT used up. You need to own one to work the Mill, and you still own it afterwards. That is the difference between equipment and an ingredient, and it is one cell.

Name: Element
Notes: The heat source. Kept, like the boiler - the Talent Tree is where a better one comes from.

Name: Brew
Notes: Made by Boiling & Hopping. This is the point of the whole map - everything before it is preparation and everything after it is storage.

Name: Barrel
Notes: Made by Cooling & Fermenting - and only after it has lagered.

Name: Bottle
Notes: ROUND AN: COUNTER = small_bottle, so a bottle is a Small Bottle in the bag (Items.csv). The Bottling Machine asks which size to fill (BottleSizes.csv); this is only used if that file has no rows for it. COUNTER blank = the resource is kept in res_<ID>, as before. Made by Bottling & Filling, several from one barrel. A bottle is what the Pub pours.
